'''Belgoth's Beacon''' was a [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]] commissioned by [[Borte Belgoth]] in approximately [[25,100 BBY]]. The satellite, one of the original beacons, was placed on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Sculpted on the beacon were the faces of a [[Columi/Legends|Columi]], [[cacodemon]], and a [[Molator/Legends|molator]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was [[Core Campaigns|destroyed]], however, during the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]]. In [[10,000 BBY]], [[Vicendi]] included the beacon in his work ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]'' as one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].
